excerpt: Fypro reads a creator's TikTok account and builds a growth plan, scripts, AI product videos and a dropshipping storefront with a customer list the creator owns. Free plan; Pro $29/month; Max $200/month. How it works, pricing and alternatives.
content:
Fypro is an AI tool for TikTok creators who want to sell to their followers. You enter your TikTok handle and connect through TikTok's official sign-in, and it analyses your niche, audience and best videos, then gives you a plan for what to post and what to sell. From there it suggests video ideas, breaks down why other videos went viral, writes scripts, and makes AI product and presenter videos. Its site says it runs on the Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 video models.

The selling side is a creator site: a brand page, link-in-bio or full store on a Fypro subdomain or your own domain, stocked with dropshipping products matched to your niche, with price and margin shown so you choose what goes live. Buyers' emails and purchase history land in an audience list you can export. Fypro says it never posts or changes your profile without permission and does not train AI models on your content. In the launch thread the team said automated email nurturing was not built yet, and that one TikTok account maps to one store.

Fypro is built by Caelith Inc., which its about page describes as an AI company in Southern California. It launched on Product Hunt on 2 July 2026, its first launch there, and finished #2 for the day with 559 upvotes and 234 comments.

We have not tested Fypro ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing, about page, terms and privacy policy, its Product Hunt page and launch discussion, and the official pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.platform: Web, connected to TikTok (Instagram publishing mentioned)
profile.summary_short: AI growth plan, videos and a dropshipping store for TikTok creators, with a customer list they own
use_cases: Getting an analysis of your TikTok account and a plan for what to post
Breaking down why a viral video worked and remaking its structure
Turning a product link into a shoppable AI video
Launching a creator store with niche-matched dropshipping products
Collecting buyers' emails in a list you can export

paragraphs: Steven Zhou says Fypro is for creators who have built a real TikTok audience but have not turned that trust into a business of their own. You drop your handle, Fypro reads what is working, and it plans and builds your site, store and content for you to review before going live.

He stressed ownership: buyers' emails and purchase history stay with the creator, not just followers on a feed. In the thread he argued the creators who convert are the ones who send followers somewhere they own and sell products that fit their niche.
launch_story.attribution: Steven Zhou, co-founder, on Product Hunt

fit: have a TikTok following and no store or email list yet
want product ideas matched to your niche rather than random trending items
want AI help with scripts and product videos
not_fit: need automated email sequences: the team said nurture emails were still being built
run several TikTok accounts and want one store: today each account maps to its own store
mainly post on platforms other than TikTok: it is built for TikTok first

pricing.intro: Fypro's pricing page lists three plans in US dollars. Plans include monthly credits for AI generation; store payments carry card fees.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 100 credits, 8 viral ideas for your niche, watermarked AI videos, starter creator site, up to 10 dropshipping products, 1 GB storage

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 600 credits a month, advanced account analysis, unlimited ideas, breakdowns and scripts, Seedance 2.0 video, no watermark, unlimited dropshipping products, payments on your site (card rates from 2.8% + $0.30), 300 GB storage

plans.name: Max
plans.detail: 7,000 credits a month, advanced AI models, card rates from 2.6% + $0.30, 2 TB storage

notes: At launch the team offered a first month of Pro for $1 with a Product Hunt code; that offer may have ended.
Fypro's site says it is used by 30,000+ creators while its Product Hunt description says 2,000+; both are the company's own figures.

alternatives.intro: Beacons, FastMoss and Nas.com are on Product Hunt's alternatives list. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Beacons
items.what: Link-in-bio, store and media kit for creators
items.difference: A creator storefront and link-in-bio; Fypro adds TikTok account analysis, AI videos and dropshipping product picks.

items.name: FastMoss
items.difference: Data on TikTok Shop products and creators; Fypro builds the creator's own store and content.

items.name: Nas.com
items.what: Platform to launch and market an online store or community
items.difference: General creator business platform; Fypro starts from your TikTok data.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Syllaby and TikTok.

liked: Helping creators own an email list instead of relying on the platform
Matching products to the creator's niche
asked: Whether it is TikTok-only (mainly yes for now)
Whether it helps nurture the email list (not yet; in development)
How products are picked (niche matching, with review of price, margin and shipping before publishing)
criticised: The team said its voice matching is closer to content style than to how a creator really talks

Product picks show price and margin, and you approve them
Customer list is exportable and owned by the creator

x.none: We found no posts about Fypro on X to link yet.

faq.a: An AI tool that analyses a TikTok account, plans and makes content, and builds a creator store stocked with niche-matched dropshipping products and an owned customer list.
Free is $0 with 100 credits; Pro is $29 a month with 600 credits; Max is $200 a month with 7,000 credits. Store payments carry card fees from 2.8% + $0.30 on Pro.

faq.q: Does it only work with TikTok?
faq.a: It is built mainly for TikTok. Its about page says Instagram publishing is already built in, and the team said more platforms will follow.

faq.q: Does Fypro pick and publish products without asking?
faq.a: No. The team said it recommends products by niche and audience, and you review price, margin, inventory and shipping before pushing them to your store.

faq.q: Can it send email campaigns to my list?
faq.a: Not yet, according to the team at launch; subscribers land in an exportable audience list, and automated sequences were in development.
Caelith Inc., which its about page describes as an AI company in Southern California.
